ic_name: DALI (Digital Addressable Lighting Interface, IEC 62386 via TI SLAA422A)

forward_frame_waveform.frame_layout: 1 start | 8-bit Address | 8-bit Data | 2 stop — total 19 bit-times Manchester.
forward_frame_waveform.address_byte: MSB first. Y = bit 7, AAAAAA = bits 6..1, B = bit 0.
forward_frame_waveform.data_byte: MSB first. Direct level (B=0) or indirect command (B=1).
forward_frame_waveform.stop_field: Two stop bits — continuous HIGH for ≥ 2 × bit-time.
forward_frame_waveform.manchester: Logic '1' = LOW→HIGH mid-bit; logic '0' = HIGH→LOW mid-bit.
forward_frame_waveform.wire_polarity: Idle HIGH (passive pull-up); transmitters pull LOW.

backward_frame_waveform.frame_layout: 1 start bit | 8-bit Data byte (MSB first) | 2 stop bits — total 11 bit-times Manchester.
backward_frame_waveform.start_bit: Logic '1' transition; only the addressed gear drives the bus during the backward window.
backward_frame_waveform.data_byte: Encodes the QUERY result (status byte, level value, version number, group bitmap, scene level, memory content, etc.).
backward_frame_waveform.stop_field: Two stop bits — continuous HIGH for ≥ 2 × bit-time.

manchester_decoder_timing.edge_detection: Re-arm DALI_RX edge interrupt at each mid-bit boundary; sample line level immediately before the next expected edge.
manchester_decoder_timing.sampling_clock_TI_us: ≈ 1 μs from MCLK = 8 MHz, far finer than required.
manchester_decoder_timing.ti_implementation_note: The MSP430F2131 does Manchester encode/decode in CPU software; timing references in §3.1 of SLAA422A say 'The Manchester encoding/decoding is performed by the CPU. The bit timing definitions are based upon the selection of the CPU (MCLK) frequency.'

fade_timing.wdt_alternative: Timer_A module replacement when fast fade times below WDT+ range are required.
